name: Dr. Dada Joseph Babatunde
institution: Elizade University, Ilara-Mokin, Ondo State, Nigeria
tagline: I teach the physics of how the world works, then build the electronics that put it to work.
about: I am a lecturer in the Department of Physics at Elizade University, Ilara-Mokin, where I help students see physics not as abstract equations but as the working principles behind real devices.

Away from the lecture hall, electronics is my craft. I design and build embedded systems and instruments, from wearable devices to environmental monitors, driven by a simple belief: understanding a principle deeply means being able to build something with it.
This dual life, physicist by profession and maker by passion, shapes everything here. Each project is an experiment, each device a lesson made tangible.

teaching.detail: Foundational mechanics, waves, and thermodynamics for undergraduate students.
Analog and digital electronics, from first principles to working circuits.
Sensors, signal conditioning, and data acquisition for the physical sciences.
